content: App Review Guidelines verified: 2.5.1 bans private APIs; 2.5.2 bans reading/writing outside app container (CFPreferencesCopyAppValue on com.apple.springboard violates); 4.2 minimum functionality bans repackaged websites; 5.2.2/5.2.3 require third-party service permission for displayed content and forbid facilitating ToS-violating streaming. June 2026 CarPlay Developer Guide confirms video app category exists but requires parked-only playback via CarPlay templates and AirPlay video support; all CarPlay apps must use templates for intended purpose; guideline 'All CarPlay flows must be possible without interacting with iPhone' and 'designed primarily to provide the specified feature'. CarTube's UIWindow+WKWebView-on-CarPlay-scene approach violates template requirements and plays video while driving.
